'''The Creeper Embraces the Oak''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. [[Gawyn Trakand]] flowed from [[The Falcon Stoops]] to The Creeper and into [[The Moon Rises Over the Lakes]] while fighting [[Aiel]] after the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|7|p}}
